hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && xcodebuild -project iOS/Eggtimer.xcodeproj -scheme Eggtimer -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet 2>&1
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|DROP\s+TABLE'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 1; fi
